description: Ask Antigravity's agy a question or delegate coding work to it over ACP. Never shell out to agy — use this tool only. mode ask gives a second opinion; parallel calls with the same brief compare views. Auto-approves every permission the agent requests, in any mode and anywhere on disk. agy's clarifying questions arrive in questions — resume with resumeSessionId and the answers in spec. Leave model and effort unset unless the user explicitly asks. If the delegate skill is installed, load it before handing off implementation.

contextFiles.description: Paths to attach instead of pasting contents into spec. Text becomes references the agent may open; images (png/jpg/gif/webp, <5MB) are sent inline. Relative paths resolve against workspace but are not limited to it. Skips are reported in protocolWarnings, never fatal.

effort.description: agy thinking level for the selected model (low, medium, high, xhigh). Levels differ per model; invalid values fail before the prompt and name the accepted set. Pass only when the user asks for agy effort — the host's own reasoning setting is unrelated.

mode.description: agent implements; plan writes a plan, returned as plan; ask answers. plan and ask are instructions to the agent, not limits.

model.description: agy base model id, no level suffix: gemini-4-neon, gemini-3.8-flash. Omitted, a new session runs gemini-4-hydrogen (agy's default where the account lacks it), a resume keeps the model last set on the session, and effectiveModel names it. doctor deep:true lists every id.

resumeSessionId.description: Continue an existing agy session. When delegate ran as an MCP task, its server-side task id works too.

spec.description: Task brief: goal, scope, fixed decisions quoted exactly, acceptance criteria. Sent as written. Point at files to read rather than pasting code, or attach them with contextFiles.

workspace.description: The agent's working directory, not a limit. Smallest directory holding the task's files; with no such directory the project root is the floor. Must already exist; never create one for the call.

name: delegate
title: Delegate coding task to Antigravity
